🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND point toward risk appetite, while TLT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND and sector divergence (Energy weak) produce a mixed picture.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit mildly supportive: HYG (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND; fear easing signaled by VXX (1W: -11.50% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND; equity breadth only moderate (6/11) keeps regime neutral.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral to slightly accommodative: TLT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND indicating bond demand while SPY/TLT ratio is flat in the regime signals, leaving financial conditions mixed.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Growth/momentum leading: XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND; clear weakness in Energy: XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND.

5. US vs Global?
US and EM both showing strength: SPY (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +6.58% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND, while China FXI (1W: -2.44% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative risk on but uneven: ARKK (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +5.34%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +5.29%) ABOVE TREND show healthy risk appetite, while IBIT (1W: +3.65% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY signals lingering crypto drawdown.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial metals firm: CPER (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.62%) ABOVE TREND; precious metals in short-term recovery with GLD (1W: +3.74% | 1M: -7.13%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +5.12% | 1M: -13.34%) RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy under pressure: XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND, USO (1W: -14.94% | 1M: -23.48%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -15.49% | 1M: -24.56%) BELOW TREND; natural gas a relative outlier: UNG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.26%) ABOVE TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Large cap tech and broad market — XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: +2.14% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: commodities/energy (USO/BNO/XLE) show pronounced weakness while several sector ETFs are in recovery or correction, indicating rotation risk.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor Growth/momentum exposure (XLK, SOXX, MTUM showing strength) and reduce exposure to Energy and broad commodity beta (XLE, USO, BNO showing weakness); bonds (TLT (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND) remain a hedge in this mixed regime.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology/Semiconductors — XLK (1W: +5.19% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +21.00%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy/Commodities — XLE (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -9.76%) BELOW TREND, USO (1W: -14.94% | 1M: -23.48%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals — CPER (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.62%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Crude oil — BNO (1W: -15.49% | 1M: -24.56%) BELOW TREND and related ETFs (USO) showing accelerated declines.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold to watch), HYG/LQD spread near 0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF relative move >1.0 would confirm tech vs financial leadership shift.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with mixed signals from strong tech/semis and weak energy. Tech and momentum ETFs showing strength (XLK, SOXX) while energy and commodity ETFs (XLE, USO, BNO) are the primary divergence to monitor.
